title: Excel Quotation Automation Tool
boundary: Create a single-entry Excel workflow that pulls linked customer data from multiple sheets, automatically populates a printable/PDF-ready quotation template, and exposes a nontechnical front end.
acceptance: Automated workbook pulls linked customer data accurately, fills the quotation without copy/paste, supports print/PDF output, and includes brief usage/maintenance notes.
result: Queued — public spec is sufficient for a synthetic customer/master-data prototype.
next_movement: Build a self-contained Excel prototype with customer/code lookup, product lines, quotation template, validation, PDF/print path and maintenance notes; adapt sheet mappings after receiving the client workbook.
blockers: Client workbook and actual customer-data sheet layout are not public.
notes: Freelancer listing was open when checked on 2026-10-03.
